description: React component implementing authentication context for managing user auth state, login, logout, and registration functions, using React hooks and context API.

methods.name: useAuth()
methods.description: Hook to access the AuthContext and retrieve auth state and methods.

methods.name: AuthProvider({ children })
methods.description: Component that provides authentication state and helper methods to child components, managing login, logout, and registration.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Asynchronous function to authenticate a user with email and password, storing token on success, updating user state.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Asynchronous function to register a new user with name, email, and password, storing token on success, updating user state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication token from local storage and resets user state.

ctags.name: user
ctags.pattern: /^  const value = { user, initializing, login, register, logout };$/

fields.name: const value = { user, initializing, login, register, logout };
